title: Satellite data and 100-year-old images reveal quickening Greenland glacier retreat
snippet: Rate of retreat for Greenland's peripheral glaciers has doubled in last 20 years. Peripheral glaciers represent 4% of Greenland's total ice-covered area but contribute 14% of island's current ice loss. Globally, all glaciers contribute roughly 21% of observed sea level rise over last two decades.
